section: Other global indices - Global Hunger Index, Environmental Performance Index, Ease of Doing Business, Global Innovation Index, World Happiness Report

accepted.s: According to the Global Gender Gap Index 2026, what was India's rank among the countries covered?
accepted.x: India was ranked 131st in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026.
accepted.tq: Use direct recall of the reported country rank while distinguishing nearby numerical options.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's performance in the Environmental Performance Index (EPI) 2026:
1. India ranked 176th out of 177 countries overall.
2. India ranked 175th in the Air Quality sub-index.
3. India ranked 130th in Climate Mitigation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: India ranked 176th of 177 overall, 175th in Air Quality and 130th in Climate Mitigation in the EPI 2026.
accepted.tq: Check the overall rank and each sub-rank separately before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: India was placed at which position in the Responsible Nations Index 2026?
accepted.x: India ranked 16th among 154 countries in the Responsible Nations Index 2026.
accepted.tq: Read both the country rank and the total number of countries together to avoid confusing the denominator.

accepted.s: With reference to StartupBlink's Innovators Business Environment Index 2026, India was ranked:
accepted.x: India occupied the 54th position in StartupBlink's Innovators Business Environment Index 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the index name and publisher context before recalling the numerical rank.

accepted.s: Which of the following is a criticism concerning the use of perception surveys and absolute-emission metrics in international indices?
o: They exclude all environmental indicators from the assessment.
They systematically favour populous developing countries.
They may disadvantage populous developing countries.
They measure only the formal employment sector of an economy.
accepted.x: Perception surveys and absolute-emission metrics may disadvantage populous developing countries, particularly because absolute emissions can be high due to population size.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated criticism to identify the consequence of the measurement approach rather than recalling a rank.
